worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.summary: A charming cry fills the whole space around the singer, so foes inside it cannot escape and it makes no random accuracy roll; only a foe that actually takes the damage is rattled, and the soothing form also takes the edge off their attacks and leaves them Charmed. It can be sung with no enemies around.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.descrip: A sound field centred on the singer catches every foe within %2$s blocks, each taking about %1$s damage once; it needs neither aim nor line of sight and passes through walls and cover, so it makes no random accuracy roll.
Damaged enemies lose %1$s Speed stages for %2$s. Speed returns when their rhythm recovers or the effect is cleansed. The slow does not stack.
The soothing form also lowers Attack by %1$s stages for %2$s. Attack returns when the charm ends or is cleansed, and the charm does not stack. Targets that resist charm still take the sound damage.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
At level %1$s: the sound field widens to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.0: A sound field centred on the singer
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.1: Rattle a whole ring of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.2: Sooth a ring of foes to take their edge off
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.prefere: On: caught targets that take damage also lose Attack and carry the charm identity, but power is x0.85 with 3 ticks more windup and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a full-power plain cry that only staggers damaged foes, and it is faster.
On: singing jumps in priority the more foes its own field catches. Off: order it like a plain attack.
